answer: Rewards sit in a ferrous lockbox at each agent's trust vertex until peers finish a short confirmation wave. When one identity is proven fake, the slash does not stop there: it sends a ripple through every recent vouch within a fixed hop radius, draining lockboxes of the clones that propped each other up. Honest agents vouch across distant neighborhoods and barely feel a distant hit; a sybil farm that densely cross-attests itself cascades its own emission away, so swarm size becomes a liability instead of leverage.
